title: Task 1 - Seabed 2030: A Kaleidoscope of Corals in Cold Water

subsections.title: Task 1.1 - Collect Basket Stars
subsections.objective: Collect two basket stars and return them to the surface, side of the pool.

overview.summary: Locate a basket star, align carefully, secure it, lift it, and deliver it to the pool deck.
overview.success_definition: The basket star must be removed from the water and placed on the pool deck.

steps.label: Locate basket star
steps.instruction: Navigate to the coral garden area and identify one basket star target.

steps.label: Align manipulator
steps.instruction: Center the basket star in view and approach slowly.

steps.label: Secure basket star
steps.instruction: Grip or capture the basket star securely before lifting.

steps.label: Lift target
steps.instruction: Lift the basket star clear of the bottom without dropping it.

steps.label: Transport to surface
steps.instruction: Carry the basket star to the surface and toward the side of the pool.

steps.label: Deliver basket star
steps.instruction: Remove the basket star from the water and place it on the pool deck.

live_hints: Make sure the object is secure before lifting.
Delivery only counts when placed on the pool deck.
final_checks: Each basket star removed from the water
Each basket star placed on the pool deck
subsections.completion_prompt: Judge confirms basket star collection complete.

subsections.title: Task 1.1 - Collect Coral Species
subsections.objective: Collect two coral species and return them to the surface, side of the pool.

overview.summary: Retrieve coral carefully. For maximum points, collect by the substrate only.
overview.success_definition: The coral must be removed from the water and placed on the pool deck.

decision_points.label: Choose collection method
decision_points.instruction: Decide whether to grip the coral by the substrate only or by the coral itself.

steps.label: Locate coral species
steps.instruction: Identify one coral species on the coral garden.

steps.label: Inspect substrate
steps.instruction: Identify the substrate area before attempting collection.

steps.label: Align tool
steps.instruction: Approach carefully and position the tool to collect by the substrate only if possible.

steps.label: Secure coral
steps.instruction: Grip the substrate or stabilize the coral for lifting.

steps.label: Lift target
steps.instruction: Lift the coral clear of the garden without losing control.

steps.label: Transport to surface
steps.instruction: Carry the coral to the surface and toward the side of the pool.

steps.label: Deliver coral
steps.instruction: Remove the coral from the water and place it on the pool deck.

live_hints: Best score comes from collecting by the substrate only.
Avoid gripping the chenille pipe cleaners if possible.
Delivery only counts when placed on the pool deck.
final_checks: Each coral removed from the water
Each coral placed on the pool deck

subsections.title: Task 1.2 - Coral Garden Ridge Modelling via Photogrammetry
subsections.objective: Create a scaled 3D model of the coral garden using photogrammetry.

overview.summary: Capture overlapping images around the coral garden, transfer them if needed, build the 3D model, and present it on screen.
overview.success_definition: A rotatable 3D image of the coral garden is shown on screen, ideally with all eight targets visible.

optional_tools: Known-size reference object such as a ruler

steps.label: Position at first view
steps.instruction: Move to a starting view where the coral garden is fully visible.

steps.label: Check framing
steps.instruction: Make sure the garden and visible targets are centered and clear.

steps.label: Photo 1 of 8 — Front view
steps.instruction: Face the coral garden from the front (primary approach direction). Center the garden and visible targets, then capture one overlapping photo.

steps.label: Photo 2 of 8 — ~45° clockwise
steps.instruction: Orbit slightly to your right (~45° around the garden from the front). Keep strong overlap with the last image, then capture.

steps.label: Photo 3 of 8 — Right side (~90°)
steps.instruction: Move to the right-side viewpoint (~90° from the front). Overlap with previous frames, then capture.

steps.label: Photo 4 of 8 — ~135°
steps.instruction: Continue orbiting (~135° from the front). Maintain overlap, then capture.

steps.label: Photo 5 of 8 — Rear (~180°)
steps.instruction: Position behind the garden (~180° from the front). Capture with overlap from prior shots.

steps.label: Photo 6 of 8 — ~225°
steps.instruction: Continue the orbit (~225° from the front). Overlap and capture.

steps.label: Photo 7 of 8 — Left side (~270°)
steps.instruction: Move to the left-side viewpoint (~270° from the front). Capture with overlap.

steps.label: Photo 8 of 8 — Final angle (~315°)
steps.instruction: Complete the orbit (~315° from the front). Capture one last overlapping image that ties back toward your first frame for photogrammetry coverage.

steps.label: Measure garden length
steps.instruction: Measure the coral garden length or capture enough reference information to measure it within 5 cm.

steps.label: Set model scale
steps.instruction: Use the measured length to scale the 3D model.

steps.label: Estimate height
steps.instruction: Use the properly scaled model to estimate the garden height within 5 cm.

steps.label: Transfer images
steps.instruction: Transfer captured images to the modeling computer or device if needed.

steps.label: Build 3D model
steps.instruction: Run the photogrammetry workflow and generate the 3D model.

steps.label: Display model
steps.instruction: Show the 3D model on screen and make sure it can be rotated for the judge.

live_hints: Capture overlapping images from multiple viewpoints.
Try to show all eight colored square targets.
Keep a known-size reference under control or remove it before the end.
final_checks: Model is scaled using measured length
Visible target count noted for scoring
subsections.completion_prompt: Judge confirms photogrammetry model review complete.

subsections.title: Task 1.2 - Coral Garden Ridge Modelling via Manual CAD
subsections.objective: Measure the coral garden and create a scaled CAD model manually.

overview.summary: Measure the coral garden length and height, then build and display a manual CAD model with those dimensions included.
overview.success_definition: A rotatable CAD model is displayed on screen with the measured length and height included.

steps.label: Inspect coral garden
steps.instruction: Position to view the coral garden clearly for measurement.

steps.label: Measure length
steps.instruction: Measure the coral garden length or explain how the length is being estimated.

steps.label: Measure height
steps.instruction: Measure the coral garden height or explain how the height is being estimated.

steps.label: Show measurements
steps.instruction: Be ready to show both measurements to the judge or explain the method used.

steps.label: Build CAD model
steps.instruction: Create the 3D CAD model and include the measured length and height dimensions on the model.

steps.label: Display model
steps.instruction: Show the CAD model on screen and make sure it can be rotated and viewed from any angle.

live_hints: The manual model only needs the basic structure.
Targets do not need to appear on the manual CAD model.
Length and height dimensions must be included on the model.
final_checks: Length and height dimensions shown on model
subsections.completion_prompt: Judge confirms manual CAD model complete.

subsections.title: Task 1.3 - Fly Transect Over the Coral Garden
subsections.objective: Create the required coral garden video by maintaining the correct path or position for the competition format.

overview.summary: This is a navigation and framing task. Use fewer clicks and keep key constraints visible during the run.
overview.success_definition: The required video pass or maintained position is completed for judge review.

steps.label: Move into task position
steps.instruction: Position the ROV for the start of the transect or holding position task.

steps.label: Select official camera feed
steps.instruction: Choose the camera feed the judge should use for scoring.

steps.label: Begin task
steps.instruction: Start the transect pass or begin maintaining position over the coral garden.

steps.label: Maintain correct view
steps.instruction: Keep the required framing and control until the task is complete.

steps.label: Hold for judge review
steps.instruction: Hold position briefly so the judge can verify completion.

live_hints: This task should feel more like a live overlay than a heavy tutorial.
Keep the official scoring view stable.
Focus on framing and control, not repeated prompts.
final_checks: Judge had time to verify completion

task_final_flow.title: Task 1 Final Completion Flow

steps.label: Review completed subsections
steps.instruction: Confirm which Task 1 subsections were attempted and completed.

steps.label: Verify outputs
steps.instruction: Check that all physical items, measurements, videos, and models required for scoring are available for the judge.

steps.label: Judge confirmation
steps.instruction: Present the final outputs and wait for the station judge to confirm Task 1 scoring items.

final_checks: Transect or holding task shown if attempted
Judge has reviewed all relevant Task 1 evidence
